label: A MAXIME_3 (strictly greatest) being is MAXIME_1 (maximal) in being, by Asymmetry: self-comparison…
rule: Asymmetry: self-comparison excluded, so the witness is distinct; then asymmetry again
meaning: Derives the MAXIME_3 to MAXIME_1 sense bridge: if being more such is asymmetric, nothing is more a being than a STRICTLY greatest being m. For y other than m, m is more a being than y, so y is not more a being than m; and m is not more a being than itself, since asymmetry excludes self-comparison.
